findings.detail: The GAV comparison denominator is present in the raw filing as Total Assets of 1,380,848 thousand, but the flagged artifact records no comparison denominator.

rationale: GAV_BDC02 is an aggregate reconciliation flag. The raw filing provides a Total Assets denominator at table 17 row 13 (1,380,848 thousand, or 1,380,848,000) and schedule/fair-value anchors at table 9 row 20 and table 23 row 5 (total investments/fair value 1,310,254 thousand/1,310,254,473). Because the flagged artifact says comparison_source=None/no comparison denominator despite a source denominator being available, this is a real extraction/anchor gap rather than an unsupported reconciliation.
